metaTitle: Custom Sublimation Coffee Mugs | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom sublimation coffee mugs with full-color designs. Perfect for promotions or gifts. Bulk pricing available at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Sublimation printing allows you to wrap your logo, photo, or artwork around the entire surface of a ceramic mug with vivid, permanent color. Unlike standard imprint methods, sublimation infuses the dye into the coating, so the design won't peel or fade after repeated dishwasher cycles. This makes custom sublimation coffee mugs ideal for employee gifts, trade show giveaways, or retail merchandise where a polished, all-over print matters. The classic 15 oz white mug provides a clean canvas for your most detailed artwork.
heroAltText: Custom sublimation coffee mugs with full-color logo print on white ceramic mugs
